---
title: "NS2 Practical 1"
author: "Cynthia Zheng"
---

I will calculate the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain - that is, the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus - regions in human, pig and mouse, and compare these results.

Total regionally elevated genes in human:
```{r}
sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
```
Total regionally elevated genes in pig:
```{r}
sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
```
Total regionally elevated genes in mouse:
```{r}
sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
```
Overall, humans had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.
